title: New Orleans VIP Jazz Club Crawl
includes: Additional alcoholic beverages can be purchased (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
A minimum of 4 people per booking is required
A maximum of 10 people per booking
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Join the leader of one of New Orleans' best-known bands for a behind-the-scenes musical experience in the Big Easy. You'll venture to three different jazz clubs, such as Fritzel's, in the French Quarter and be treated to premier seats while your host plays during live shows. Meet local band members and sip a cocktail at each venue during this 3-hour VIP experience.

This experience needs a minimum of 10 guests to operate. Thank you for your understanding.
